Elongated_Rostral_Skull.description: A highly elongated dolichocephalic skull designed to house a staggering surface area of internal olfactory epithelium. While trading away the bite-force leverage of shorter faces, it maximizes scent-gathering potential perfectly.

Sagittal_Crest_Cranium.description: A massive, heavy skull featuring an incredibly prominent bony sagittal crest running along the top. This crest serves purely as an anchor point for tremendously overpowered temporalis jaw muscles, granting a literal bone-crushing bite.
